verdict.rationale: RustDesk Server Pro documents a web console, device groups, a shared address book, and per-user and device-group access control. That covers organizing machines and users with per-group policies, though it is a paid Pro feature rather than part of Server OSS. The evidence is short first-party summary text plus a pricing-page feature list. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how groups and access policies are configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the address book and group access control.

support.subject: As an IT admin, machines and users are organized in a shared address book or console with per-group access policies

citations.quote: Server Pro adds a web console, device groups, a shared address book, per-user and device-group access control, audit logs, and a management API.
